title: ABS light on

causes.text: Malfunction in the ABS or brake assist system
causes.document: 2022 Toyota Camry Owner's Manual OM06244U (year mapping per Helm listing; manual is Camry-specific)

urgency.text: ABS light alone: have vehicle inspected immediately
urgency.document: 2022 Toyota Camry Owner's Manual OM06244U (year mapping per Helm listing; manual is Camry-specific)

urgency.text: ABS + brake warning light both on: stop in a safe place immediately
urgency.document: 2022 Toyota Camry Owner's Manual OM06244U (year mapping per Helm listing; manual is Camry-specific)
urgency.quote: Stop your vehicle in a safe place immediately and contact your Toyota dealer. The vehicle will become extremely unstable during braking, and the ABS system may fail

guidancePrimary: Not yet verified (no universal source); brand quotes are vehicle-specific extras only
